query:
SELECT leagueId, homeTeam, awayTeam, 
  FROM_UNIXTIME(kickoffUtcMs/1000) as kickoff_utc,
  round, status
FROM matches
WHERE leagueId IN ('4481', '5071', '4480')
  AND kickoffUtcMs > UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-05-01') * 1000
ORDER BY kickoffUtcMs ASC
LIMIT 20;
